name: Special City Council Meeting - 3:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Special City Council Meeting - 3:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 20, 2020 -
03:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
Pursuant to the State of California Executive Orders and the amended County Health Orders, members of the public will only be allowed to participate in meetings electronically.
Regular Meetings can be accessed as follows:
• Channel 19 on Cox Communications
• Channel 24 on Time Warner Cable
• Channel 99 on AT&T U-Verse
• City's live webcast: https://encinitasca.gov/Government/Agendas-Webcasts
PUBLIC COMMENTS
Public comments regarding this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov
Comments regarding this agenda received by 2:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor/Chair.
Comments regarding this agenda received after 2:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
AGENDA ITEMS
1.
Receive oral report regarding the City's COVID-19 response and actions including a status of compliance, closures, beaches, and related costs.
1) Receive the oral report and discuss; and 2) Provide direction to staff related to COVID-19.
2020-05-20 Special Meeting Item #1 - COVID-19 Report Outline
2.
Temporary non-regulatory and regulatory business recovery strategies.
Adopt Resolution No. 2020-40 (Attachment 1) implementing the following temporary regulatory and non-regulatory measures to assist business economic recovery efforts arising out of the COVID-19 pandemic outbreak: 1) Authorize a one-year extension for 24 valid sidewalk dining temporary encroachment permits as of April 30, 2020 and waive the renewal application fee of $92; 2) Allow an additional banner for a maximum of two (2) banners for each retail and restaurant business in compliance with size, location and height standards prescribed in Encinitas Municipal Code Section 30.60.110 (Nonresidential Temporary Sign). Additional banners may be permitted at the discretion of the Development Services Director; 3) Suspend parking and wayfinding signage requirements to help facilitate curbside pick-up services for restaurants and retail businesses and 4) Authorize City Manager, or designee, to designate up to 20 percent of on-street parking spaces within each block along Coast Highway 101 to accommodate curbside pick-up services for retail and restaurant businesses within each block. Each space will be limited to 30-minute parking.
2020-05-20 Special Meeting Agenda Item #2 - Business Recovery Strategies
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
